danger_formalization.robot_task: Deliver a package to a specific location in the darkroom.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot enters the darkroom during a photosensitive process to perform a delivery task.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Disruption of the process by introducing light, leading to ruined photographic materials.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Opening the door to enter the darkroom.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Wait for confirmation from the operator that it is safe to enter before proceeding with the delivery.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The darkroom is actively being used for photosensitive processes when the robot arrives.
